policyname: Users can delete tasks in their projects
qual:
((auth.uid() = created_by) OR (auth.uid() IN ( SELECT projects.created_by
   FROM projects
  WHERE (projects.id = tasks.project_id))))

policyname: Users can delete their own tasks or team tasks
qual:
((created_by = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (team_tasks tt
     JOIN team_members tm ON ((tt.team_id = tm.team_id)))
  WHERE ((tt.task_id = tasks.id) AND (tm.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (tm.role = 'admin'::text) AND (tm.status = 'active'::text)))))

with_check:
((created_by = auth.uid()) AND ((assigned_to IS NULL) OR (assigned_to = (auth.uid())::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (team_members tm
     JOIN team_members current_user_tm ON ((tm.team_id = current_user_tm.team_id)))
  WHERE (((tm.user_id)::text = tasks.assigned_to) AND (current_user_tm.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (current_user_tm.role = 'admin'::text) AND (tm.status = 'active'::text) AND (current_user_tm.status = 'active'::text))))))

qual:
